sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: A MusicBrainz work's window lists its recordings as the Discogs label window lists its releases: 100 when it opens, then "Load 5 more pages" (500 recordings, about 6 s), with Stop, a progress bar and "Try again" for a page that failed; a filter over title and artist, a chip per artist credit (Ctrl-click adds one, "+N more" past ten) and the three-way sort. What is loaded is kept in the browser like the card, so a later window shows it without asking again. Until now the window showed the first 100 and sent you to the work's page for the rest.

A Discogs label's releases: Ctrl-click on a format chip adds a second format, "+N more" shows formats past the first ten, and a release without a picture keeps an empty square so every row is as high.
Performance: link-preview windows only; no change to the page tables' filter, sort or render path.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: The windows' tables are two shared components with one click handler for every window (org/MB-POH-sync-withDiscogs.org, Phase 2): a Compact table (a Discogs label's sublabels) and a List table (a label's releases, a work's recordings), plus a paged loader for MusicBrainz lists that the other MusicBrainz windows will use next.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Every sortable table in a Discogs window (an artist's discography, a label's releases and sublabels, a master's versions) and the release-group window's releases table now has three sort states: ascending, descending, and a third click back to the order the site gives. A heading in that initial order shows a faint ⇅ (the release-group window's ↕ became ⇅ too), and its hover text says what the next click does.
A Discogs artist's Have heading now also sorts the other way on the second click (fewest first) before returning to Discogs' order; until now its second click went straight back.
Performance: link-preview windows only; no change to the page tables' filter, sort or render path.
